headline: Crude collapsed while *energy ran the Nifty*
subline: FIIs bought Rs 3,114.68 Cr while DIIs trimmed. Banks and IT lagged the rally.
hero_text: FIIs bought Rs 3,114.68 Cr in cash while DIIs sold Rs 392.2 Cr. Foreign money backed a 1.68 percent Nifty gain.

why.title: Oil and gas ripped higher
why.desc: Nifty Oil & Gas jumped as crude prices fell.

why.title: Metals rode commodity strength
why.desc: Nifty Metal rose on firm global commodity prices.

why.title: Foreign buyers outweighed DIIs
why.desc: FIIs bought Rs 3,114.68 Cr while DIIs sold Rs 392.2 Cr.

why.title: Brent crude cracked lower
why.desc: Brent dropped to 105.81 from 117.64 in one session.

sector_reasons.Media: Slipped while the wider tape rose
sector_reasons.IT: Infosys fell and dragged the group

bonus_text: 1,956 stocks advanced and 738 declined, a ratio of 2.65. Inside the Nifty 50, 38 rose and 12 fell.
movers_note_gainers: Reliance jumped 11.6%, with Tata Steel and JSW Steel next.
movers_note_losers: Infosys fell most. ICICI Bank, Dr Reddy's and Kotak trailed.
watch_text: Tuesday is Nifty expiry day. Open interest is stacked at 23,000 puts and 24,000 calls.
lessons: One heavyweight carried the index. Reliance outran every other Nifty name by a wide margin.
Banks and IT sat out the rally. Private banks and Infosys slipped while energy ran.
Commodity linked groups ran the board. Oil, energy, metals and infra topped the sector list.
The frontline led the size ladder. Midcaps and smallcaps rose, but by less than the Nifty.
alert_text: US JOLTS at 00:30 IST and the US Congressional Elections at 00:46 IST land before the Tuesday open.
cta_headline: A crude shock day. *Save it for Tuesday*.
cta_sub: Next bell is Tuesday 3 November, with the Nifty weekly expiry.
next_text: Tuesday 3 November brings Nifty weekly expiry. Infosys also goes ex dividend of Rs 26.
caption_a:
Brent crude fell 10.06% and the Nifty still jumped 1.68% to 23,440.8.
Oil & Gas rose 5.95% and Metal 3.21%.
FIIs bought Rs 3,114.68 Cr while DIIs sold Rs 392.2 Cr.
Watch: Nifty weekly expiry falls on Tuesday.
